preregistration.innerFoldRule: Within each outer training set, sort remaining animal IDs within each breed and assign one animal per breed to each of five fixed inner folds. Each inner fold tests four animals and trains on the other sixteen.
preregistration.primaryMetric: equal-animal mean of per-animal F1 for RE and RU, each class and animal equally weighted
tieBreakers: higher minimum of equal-animal RE and RU recall
simpler candidate: static logistic, temporal logistic, then shallower CART; lower C before higher C

preprocessing.windowRule: MI_t and four prior MI values at exactly one-minute intervals, within the same animal; gaps reset the feature history; no outcome labels are features.

staticAllRowsReference.note: Frozen existing static-only six-fold results on all 8,864 rows; not directly comparable to the 5,582-row temporally complete subset.

limitations: Metrics estimate held-out-animal performance within the sampled source; all outer folds reuse both ranches and all four breeds.
The source contains 24 animals and repeated minute observations; the effective independent groups are animals, not rows.
Only one scalar motion index is available; no raw axes or physiology are evaluated.
Behavior labels are video-reviewed minute annotations; short behaviors may inherit labels from adjacent minutes, so temporal performance can benefit from annotation persistence.
This behavior task does not validate DMI, ADG, BR-CORTE, lameness, or the Riose engine.
Outer candidate metrics are descriptive; only inner grouped predictions select the model in each outer fold.
